description: Animated map speech bubbles for RPG Maker MV 1.6.1+ and MZ. Convert the next Show Text into a nonblocking bubble with supported text codes, themes, wrapping, and character tracking.
features: Convert the next Show Text into a nonblocking bubble in MV or MZ
Engine variable/name/currency codes, icons, colors, and supported inline font changes
Centered multiline text, wrapping, stacking, and bounce/fade animations
Map bubbles follow events, the player, or followers
Unsupported message features fall back to normal dialogue
Preset themes and custom backgrounds; legacy direct commands remain available
installation: Download the release ZIP and copy FugsChatBubbles.js into your game's js/plugins folder.
Enable FugsChatBubbles in Plugin Manager. Requires MV 1.6.1+ with updated project runtime/core files, or MZ.
MV: add ChatBubble next event:current duration:5, followed by Show Text.
MZ: select Next Show Text as Bubble, followed by Show Text.
Use the normal Show Text editor for dialogue and supported text codes. See the README for fallbacks and compatibility limits.
